# Local modifications to vendored Stwo

**None.** The vendored tree is pristine at the pinned commit
`289c20de80b7c7f508de9c46151fb81dae404154` (`v2.2.0`).

Per [RFC-0015](../../../docs/rfcs/RFC-0015-third-party-vendoring-and-pinning.md),
every local modification to the vendored source is recorded here as an ordered
pair `NNNN-<slug>.patch` + `NNNN-<slug>.md` (the rationale, audit note, and
upstream PR/issue link). Because there are no modifications, `patches_sha256` in
`REVISION` is the SHA-256 of the empty set
(`e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855`).
